summary: Regression tested the TRADE PRICING (per-product fixed £/percent discount, no blanket 5%) and UNIT-PRODUCT display changes end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite (9 tests, 100% pass) covering serialize_tile_for_shop unit fields, /api/tiles/pricing/calculate fixed-£ trade resolution (11.99 inc-VAT → 9.99 ex-VAT), no blanket default trade discount, percent path, query-param override, guest path, and guest-checkout TN-zone delivery maths (100 + 29.99 = 129.99, congestion 0; test order deleted). Frontend (Playwright, real preview URL): GUEST PDP + cart flows all PASS. TRADE PDP main price (£9.99 ex VAT), credit-back badge (+2%), pallet chips (£9.99 / £10.21 / £9.58 with 'ex VAT' header) and TRADE pallet cart (£9.58/each, subtotal £574.80, 'Credit back you'll earn £11.50', no blanket Trade −5% line) all PASS. TWO REAL BUGS FOUND: (1) Trade Volume Pricing table first tier shows £10.79 ex VAT instead of ≈£9.99 — fixed £ discount passed to VolumePricingTable as a raw percent; (2) Trade NON-pallet 'Per unit' cart line shows £9.88 instead of £9.99 and a 'Trade −1.11%' savings chip — TileCartContext.addToCart drops trade_discount_type when persisting the line, AND retail_price_inc_vat is stored as the already-trade-discounted 11.99 instead of retail 13.10 (double-discount risk).

ui_bugs.component: VolumePricingTable (Trade Volume Pricing table on PDP)
ui_bugs.issue: For ULT-EC (fixed £1.11 trade discount) the trade table shows first tier 'Your Price' £10.79 ex VAT and 'Extra 1% Off', while the main price block correctly shows £9.99 ex VAT / 'Trade: 8% off'. CollectionDetailPage passes tradeDiscount={productTradeDiscount || 0} (raw 1.11) and the component treats it as a PERCENT; it must receive getEffTradePct() (8.47%) or also receive trade_discount_type. Also makes tiersMatchProduct false so the whole trade table is recalculated wrongly (all tiers off: 10.79/10.26/9.72/9.18 instead of 9.99/9.49/8.99/8.49).

Unit product ULT-EC still shows m² quantity labels in the volume table rows ('0 - 10m²', '10 - 50m²' ...) even though the column header correctly reads 'Price/each'. Labels come from the backend tier.label; should read units/each for pallet_qty_unit='unit' / non-surface products.

TWO toasts fire for a single add — TileCartContext.addToCart shows 'Added 60 units (Full Pallet) to cart' and CollectionDetailPage then shows 'Added Full Pallet (60 units) to cart!'. Both are unit-correct, but duplicated. Same on m² products ('Added 2.88m² to cart' + 'Added 2.88 m² (2 boxes) to cart!').
Trade line savings chip renders 'Trade −1.11%' for a fixed £1.11/unit discount (raw value rendered as a percent). Should read 'Trade −£1.11' (or the effective 8%).

For a Full-Pallet trade line (which gets NO trade discount by design) the summary still says 'Volume + Trade discounts saved you £7.66 across 1 line · 1% off retail' — derived from the same raw 1.11-as-percent value. Should be trade-discount-free for pallet_tier lines.

integration_issues.flow: TRADE user adds non-pallet 'Per unit' qty 1 of ULT-EC → cart
integration_issues.issue: Cart line shows £9.88 / each ex VAT, expected £9.99. RCA: (a) TileCartContext.addToCart does NOT persist trade_discount_type (nor isTrade) — localStorage item is {price:9.99, retail_price_inc_vat:11.99, trade_discount:1.11, credit_back_rate:2} with no type — so cartPricing.getEffectivePrice defaults to 'percent' and computes 11.99*(1-1.11%)/1.2 = 9.88. (b) CollectionDetailPage passes retail_price_inc_vat = currentPrice = 11.99 (already trade-net inc-VAT) instead of the £13.10 retail; if only (a) is fixed the cart would compute 11.99−1.11 = 10.88/1.2 = £9.07 (double discount) and a trade→guest logout would show £11.99 as 'retail'. BOTH must be fixed together.

action_items: CollectionDetailPage.js ~line 3094: pass the % equivalent (getEffTradePct()) — or trade_discount + trade_discount_type — to VolumePricingTable so fixed £ discounts render the correct trade tier table (first tier must be £9.99 ex VAT, not £10.79).
TileCartContext.addToCart: persist trade_discount_type (and isTrade) on the cart line so fixed £ discounts are not re-applied as percentages by cartPricing.getEffectivePrice.

CollectionDetailPage addToCart: set retail_price_inc_vat to the true retail inc-VAT (room_lot_price / list price, £13.10) — currently it stores the trade-discounted 11.99, which double-discounts once the type bug is fixed and understates retail after trade logout.
TileCartPage: render fixed £ trade discounts as '£X' (not 'X%') in the per-line savings strip, and exclude pallet_tier lines from the 'Volume + Trade discounts saved you …' summary.
Remove the duplicate add-to-cart toast (keep either the context toast or the PDP toast).
Use unit-aware tier labels ('0 - 10 units') in the volume pricing table for pallet_qty_unit='unit'/non-surface products.
critical_code_review_comments: cartPricing.getEffectivePrice correctly branches on trade_discount_type, but the value never reaches it because the cart writer drops the field — the contract between TileCartContext.addToCart's whitelist and cartPricing must be documented/asserted (one shared item-shape helper).

retail_price_inc_vat is documented as 'canonical retail inc-VAT' but CollectionDetailPage assigns currentPrice which for trade users is the trade-net tier price — the invariant is violated at the source.

VolumePricingTable takes a bare tradeDiscount percent while the rest of the PDP is type-aware (getEffTradePct); the prop should be the effective percent or include the type to avoid this class of bug.

Verified PASSING and should stay passing: guest PDP pallet chips inc-VAT (£13.10/£12.25/£11.50, no 'ex VAT'), Full Pallet snaps qty to 60 + total £690.00, guest cart '£11.50 / each' + '60 pcs', trade PDP £9.99 ex VAT + pdp-credit-back-badge '+2% credit back on this item' + pallet chips 9.99/10.21/9.58 with 'ex VAT', trade pallet cart £9.58/each, subtotal £574.80, cart-credit-back-row '£11.50', no blanket Trade −5% line, Sherwood Oak m² regression clean (no console/page errors). STILL FAILING after fix must be re-checked: (1) Trade Volume Pricing table first tier should be £9.99 ex VAT (currently £10.79); (2) trade non-pallet Per-unit line must be £9.99 in cart (currently £9.88) with savings chip 'Trade −£1.11'. Remember localStorage.clear() between guest and trade runs; each browser_automation call is a fresh context so log in within the same script.
rca_of_the_issue: Both failures share one root cause: the per-product trade discount is stored as a VALUE + TYPE ('fixed' £1.11 / 'percent'), but two consumers use the raw value as if it were a percent. (a) CollectionDetailPage passes productTradeDiscount (1.11) into VolumePricingTable as tradeDiscount%, so the component's tiersMatchProduct guard fails (11.99/(1-0.0111)=12.12 vs 13.10) and it recomputes 13.10*(1-1.11%)/1.2 = £10.79 with 'Extra 1% Off'. (b) TileCartContext.addToCart's item whitelist omits trade_discount_type, so cartPricing.getEffectivePrice falls back to 'percent' and computes 11.99*(1-1.11%)/1.2 = £9.88; compounding this, retail_price_inc_vat is written as the trade-net 11.99 rather than retail 13.10, so even the correct 'fixed' branch would yield £9.07. Pallet-tier lines are unaffected because they skip the trade discount entirely, which is why the £9.58 pallet flow looks correct.
